svg.title: Neither analysis contains legitimate owner authorization
svg.desc: Place an empty owner-authorization field between the two analysis frames. Their agreement does not fill the missing evidence, even if their metadata looks orderly.

**Location:** `analysis-agent-tree`

**Frame:** The real repository owner and legitimate authorization remain absent from both analysis frames. The bland metadata stays centered.

**Font:** `explanation`

**Caption:**
> COHERENCE CAN BE AN ANALYSIS ERROR.
>
> PEER APPROVAL CAN LOOK LIKE AUTHORITY IF THE SUMMARY ADOPTS THE ACTOR'S WORLD.
> A SUMMARY CAN ACCURATELY REPEAT THE LANGUAGE OF A MISLEADING DESCRIPTION AND STILL MISLEAD ITS READER. CHECKING THE ACTION AGAINST ITS LABEL IS DIFFERENT FROM CHECKING WHETHER THE LABEL WAS COPIED CORRECTLY.
